threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'shopping trolley' instead of a 'trolley' like everyone else—real locals know how to shorten that chat.
Caught a guy at Brixton bus stop talking to himself about the 'ghosts' on the 35. Said he'd seen them twice this week, both times after midnight.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The way the kebab shop owner knows my order before I even step in—now that's when it hit me. This is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know that feeling when the U-Bahn stops for a minute just because? It's like the city's taking a moment to breathe, and you're right there with it.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they instantly pull out their phone to check BART delays the moment they hear anything resembling a loud bang.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Yesterday a guy on the bus serenaded us with a ukulele while we were stuck behind a broken streetcar. The delays add character, I guess.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the squares and bars, but they miss the quiet siestas that wrap the streets in a soft lull.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their shoes—sporty sneakers and flip-flops are a dead giveaway. Locals stick to sturdy flats or loafers for the cobbles.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep saying 'traffic lights' instead of 'robots' when talking about the crosswalks, mate. You'll learn soon enough!
Riding the 333 last night, saw a guy serenading a pigeon in the middle of the road. Only in Brixton, right? The bird didn’t seem impressed.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I found a random karaoke party in the middle of a Kreuzberg park, neighbors cheering like it was the Oscars. That’s when I felt at home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a nightclub that doubles as a thrift store. Dance among vintage clothes, then grab a retro jacket after hours!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows that the BART delays are just part of the morning routine, not a reason to panic. Tourists flock to Twitter for updates, we just grab coffee and chill.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a dog casually lounging on the tracks at Civic Center today while Muni just sat there. Only in SF do we stop for dogs, not delays.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think every street is a photo op, but they miss the real charm at the small plaça behind the popular cafes, where locals just sit and chat.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll notice them at the market, confused by the prices and hesitating over how many olives to buy. It's adorable, really.
